info.title: How we read GPS
info.body:
• The phone sends a position about every 8 seconds, each with its GPS accuracy (usually 5–20 m on open roads).
• The vehicle counts as stopped when its speed is below 3 km/h and it stays within the accuracy radius of the parked point; the position is pinned to that point so the line does not zigzag.
• Points with accuracy above 50 m (tunnels, tall buildings) are not drawn on the route but still keep the connection alive.
• While sharing, the app runs a background service with a persistent notification, so positions keep flowing with the screen locked; force-closing the app or losing signal for over 2 minutes shows as "signal lost".
